title: Jammy Dutch Cake Bake
description: A cozy, dense Dutch dessert featuring cocoa powder, perfect for a diabetes-friendly treat.

ingredients.name: granulated sweetener (such as Swerve or Erythritol)

instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit (175 degrees Celsius).
Grease a 9-inch (23-centimeter) round cake pan and set aside.
In a large mixing bowl, whisk together almond flour, cocoa powder, salt, and baking powder.
In a separate bowl, cream together butter and granulated sweetener until light and fluffy.
Beat in eggs one at a time, followed by vanilla extract.
Gradually add dry ingredients to wet ingredients, mixing until a smooth batter forms.
Fold in Greek yogurt until well combined.
Pour batter into prepared cake pan and smooth top.
Dot the top of the cake with jam.
Bake for 30-35 minutes or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
Remove from oven and let cool in pan for 5 minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.
